title: Panels: one icon strip on the far left opens every panel, several side by side
summary: The left sidebar, the right-hand panel slot, the Git panel slot and their top-bar buttons are replaced by one icon strip on the far left; panels open beside it side by side in strip order, resize, refuse to open without room, and come back after a restart.
lessons_learned: The panel list lives in src/components/panels/panels.ts plus PANEL_IDS in the panel strip store; the Files, PROJECTS pill and Triggers stories each add one entry there

deferred.what: The Git panel's inner content keeps a 320 px minimum width, so when the strip panel is resized to 240-320 px the right side of the Git panel is cut off
deferred.why: The issue said each panel's content stays unchanged
